episode.title: Zheng Yi Sao: The Undefeated Pirate Queen

synopsis: Pirate leader Zheng Yi Sao forced an imperial amnesty in 1810 and retired with her massive treasure intact.
narration: In 1810, pirate commander Zheng Yi Sao forced Qing imperial envoys into a full amnesty after commanding seventy thousand sailors. She surrendered her battle fleet on her own terms, kept her vast fortune, and retired peacefully.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 view of hundreds of red-sailed junks filling a misty bay in 1810 in the South China Sea. A sharp-featured female commander in silk battle robes stands at a wooden ship prow, staring calmly down imperial messengers holding imperial pardon scrolls.

Extreme close-up of heavy gold coins and official government seals poured onto a polished teak table on a flagship deck, while red silk banners sway in ocean wind behind the quiet commander looking out over calm coastal waters.

music: Fast, tense, percussive underscore powered by pounding taiko drums, rapid gong scrapes, and aggressive low strings. Hits immediately with high velocity, driving an intense nautical rhythm through sharp syncopated beats, breaking off mid-groove to loop back seamlessly to the start.
